scope: project fit and focused product direction
Studio cache mutability and request-body security

findings.resolution: The final INSTALL slice now requires the official remote piped dry-run after push, not only the mocked local regression.
The performance threshold is limited to three measurements on the audited host and will not be generalized.
The locale slice now requires ordinary and GitHub Pages packaged route evidence.
Pages and macOS are separate outcome layers and failures must be reported rather than hidden behind push success.

decision: The revised plan is project-fit, preserves Kacha's canonical media boundaries and is ready to freeze after content digest binding. Independent final implementation approval remains outside the producer review.
